setup.title: Set up your practice
setup.description: Choose a tempo and input method. Use the touch piano or computer keyboard, and toggle the piano or falling notes.

score.title: Score
score.subtitle: Play along with the score; note feedback appears as you play.

keyboard.label: Virtual piano
keyboard.title: Piano keys
keyboard.rangeHint: Some notes are outside the five-octave view. Change its starting C to see and play them.

keyboardGuide.title: Playing with your keyboard
keyboardGuide.stepInput: In setup, choose “Computer keyboard” to use letter keys, or “Tap the on-screen piano” to play by touching the piano.
keyboardGuide.stepRange: The C range selector shows five octaves. With a computer keyboard, the letter keys play the first octave of the selected range.
keyboardGuide.stepPlay: Note colors indicate hands: right hand is blue and left hand is orange. Press the matching key when a note reaches the play line, or tap its on-screen piano key.
keyboardGuide.stepFeedback: Check the result below the piano: green means in time, yellow means early/late, and red means wrong note or missed. Change the C range if notes are outside the visible piano.
keyboardGuide.keyMap: Computer keys play one octave using this map:

recovery.title: Another practice session is active
recovery.sameScore: This account still has an active session for this score. It was left behind after the page was reloaded, so its scoring position cannot be restored.
recovery.otherScore: This account still has an active session for another score. Only one practice session per account can run at a time.
recovery.sameScoreConfirm: Aborting the old session will mark it abandoned. Saved events remain in history, but the session cannot be resumed.
recovery.otherScoreConfirm: The old session may still be in use in another tab. Only confirm if you are sure you no longer want to continue it.
recovery.warning: After aborting it, you can start a new practice session on this page.
recovery.aborted: The old session was aborted. You can start a new practice session.

display.title: Practice display
display.enableKeyboardForTouch: Turn on the virtual piano to continue with touch input.

waterfall.title: Falling notes
waterfall.hint: Notes fall toward the hit line using the selected tempo and measure range.
waterfall.label: Falling note map by pitch and time
